summary: The final smoke-evidence implementation leaves one removed protection unreplaced and still consults the working tree despite the fix entry’s stated contract.

blockers.defect: The delta removes the explicit rejection of ignored paths without replacing it or explaining why it is obsolete.
blockers.evidence: Patch 008 removes `assertTracked(context.repo, absolute, field)`. At `team-config/agent/skills/review-work/scripts/validate-gate-record.mjs:316-321`, that helper rejects ignored paths using `git check-ignore --no-index`; the replacement at lines 828-866 checks the committed blob but does not check ignore rules. A force-added smoke log on an ignored path can therefore pass, contrary to fix entries 5 and 7 and SKILL.md:114.
blockers.change: Restore an explicit ignored-path check while retaining the reviewed-commit blob checks, and add a regression case for a force-added ignored smoke log.

blockers.defect: Smoke validation still depends on the current working-tree path, contrary to fix entry 8.
blockers.evidence: `requireSmokeRow` calls `assertInsideRepo` at `team-config/agent/skills/review-work/scripts/validate-gate-record.mjs:834`; that helper resolves the current filesystem path and rejects an outside-repository symlink at lines 300-310. Thus a valid regular smoke blob at reviewed SHA and HEAD can be rejected solely because its working-tree file was replaced by a symlink outside the repository, although entry 8 says the working tree plays no part.
blockers.change: Use lexical repository containment for the Git-object lookup, without resolving the working-tree artifact, and add a control replacing the working-tree path after committing a valid smoke blob.
